## Verdict

missing

## Bearer

RaceRecordingRepository — core-domain/.../race/RaceRecordingRepository.kt (implemented by app-wear/.../race/RaceRecordingRepositoryImpl.kt)

## Trigger

`ControlViewModel.onStopConfirmed`, calling `stopRaceController.stop(heldRace.id, atInstant)` which calls `recordingRepository.stopRace(raceId, atInstant)` — observed, and already passing a real `Instant`

## Today

`RaceRecordingRepositoryImpl.stopRace(raceId, atInstant)` never reads `atInstant`. It only sets `completion` to `INCOMPLETE` and clears
`currentSegmentIndex`/`currentSegmentOpenedAt`; the abandoned segment keeps no duration. The interface's own doc on `stopRace` already
states the abandoned segment is "never truncated" to `atInstant`, but says nothing about the parameter being otherwise unused. `Race`
carries no end-time field at all (id, name, date, origin, isReference, completion, segments, retainedFactors, rejectedCalibrations,
currentSegmentIndex, currentSegmentOpenedAt, sentAt — no endedAt or equivalent), so a race's total duration is always the sum of its
closed segments' durations, with no way to record when the race actually stopped.

## Expected

Either `stopRace` uses `atInstant`: it stores it on the race (a new field on `Race`, e.g. `endedAt`), so a race carries a recorded end
time distinct from the sum of its segment durations. Or the parameter goes: `stopRace` drops `atInstant` from its signature, and
`RaceRecordingRepository`'s contract for `stopRace` says explicitly that no instant is taken and no end time is recorded — the total
stays the sum of the segments. `StopRaceController.stop` and `ControlViewModel.onStopConfirmed` follow whichever signature is kept.

## Searched

stopRace, atInstant, endedAt, stoppedAt, Race.kt fields, currentSegmentOpenedAt
